dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日本医師会標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses MCP (Medical Care Platform) framework with MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA linkage convention

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – patient name search screen (P97) within patient registration subsystem
purpose.summary: This program implements the patient name search screen (P97) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles screen initialization, input entry, and display of patient search results including name, sex, birthdate, insurance combination, and hospitalization status. It interacts with multiple master files (patient master, insurance combination, reception history) via COPY-included record layouts and external subprogram CALLs.

notable_features: MCP (Medical Care Platform) event-driven screen framework replacing EXEC CICS
21 COPY statements for shared record layouts and subprogram interfaces
OCCURS 100 table for patient search result list
INDEXED BY clause on SRYKA table
REDEFINES usage for age display formatting
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric fields
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, causing Japanese comments to appear as garbled latin-1 characters. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~75906 bytes; full procedure division not visible but structure is clear from what is shown. Program type classified as online-cics equivalent because it uses the MCP event-driven windowing framework analogous to CICS but specific to ORCA/GnuCOBOL on Linux.
